name: alakazam_ml_v24
model: The v20 LightGBM action ranker and its guarded live scope are unchanged. The bounded card-ID-agnostic target ranker was retrained only on the current 1000 Yushin Ito replays.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, wins, damage, KO, prize tiers, Boss use, Grimmsnarl pressure, Dudunsparce pivots, and every non-target decision. The target model contributes at most +/-800 inside deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: Expert play rejects unconditional ex gusting, but learned target features substantially improve same-tier ordering. v24 separately guarantees a concrete multi-prize KO after the real Boss hand cost.

v24_rule_changes: Admit a same-turn benched ex or Mega ex KO even when the opposing Active is not KO-able.
Compare identical Active and Bench ex copies by their current HP and real post-Boss damage.
Remove the v23 blanket high-role single-prize exception from a guaranteed multi-prize KO gate while preserving an Active game-winning KO.
Keep attacking an Active Grimmsnarl ex instead of early-gusting Munkidori or a substitute one-prizer when the ex is a clean visible two-hit; retain one-prize targets as the no-route fallback.
Treat one or two remaining deck cards as a safe Active Dudunsparce cycle only when the resulting promotion creates a same-turn Alakazam KO.
Allow an Energy attachment and retreat from Dudunsparce only when its full three-Energy retreat cost is met and the promoted Alakazam KOs.
Retrain the bounded card-ID-agnostic target ranker on the current Yushin Ito 1000 replay corpus.
preserved_v23_invariants: v22 backup ETA, continuity, Dunsparce rebuild, and backup pre-attachment
v22 attack-route promotion and shield switching
terminal Boss and terminal Active win gates
Mist Energy Hammer memory and effect-prevention handling
normal deck floors, exact-KO hand protection, and Fezandipiti exposure gates
known_limitations: A new live ladder rating has not been measured; 900/1000 stability is a goal, not a validated outcome.
Teacher-forced comparison does not simulate the counterfactual trajectory after a changed action.
A recorded expert action is preference data, not proof of a unique globally optimal action.
Opening-hand variance and hidden information cannot be eliminated by deterministic routing.
No official cg package is present locally, so only a source ZIP can be produced.
